title: Qiskit Aer Simulator with ZNE - notebook and script divergent behavior
body: ### **Describe the bug** I am trying to run ZNE Quantum Error Mitigation technique with Qiskit Aer Simulator via a noise model retrieved from a backend "ibm_kingston". **Running the code as a python script normally on the terminal vs a python notebook has distinct behavior**: Local mode silently ignores `resilience.zne_mitigation`. The script appears to terminate only because `job.result()` is never awaited and the interpreter exits before Aer's background workers finish; in a Jupyter kernel those workers persist and continue the (very large, 30-qubit, noisy, mirrored Trotter) simulation. So the bug is that `Estimator.run()` in local mode returns a job whose worker lifecycle isn't tied to the parent process, which makes the "script vs notebook" behavior diverge confusingly. The python code for the same is added below: [zne.py](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/27385887/zne.py) The output of the above code: ```bash API Key: qiskit_runtime_service._discover_account:WARNING:2026-05-05 00:33:43,541: Loading account with the given token. A saved account will not be used. qiskit_runtime_service.__init__:WARNING:2026-05-05 00:33:45,794: Instance was not set at service instantiation. Free and trial plan instances will be prioritized. Based on the following filters: (tags: None, region: us-east, eu-de), and available plans: (open), the available account instances are: open-instance. If you need a specific instance set it explicitly either by using a saved account with a saved default instance or passing it in directly to QiskitRuntimeService(). qiskit_runtime_service.backends:WARNING:2026-05-05 00:33:45,794: Using instance: open-instance, plan: open /home/ayush268/.pyenv/versions/qem_profiler-0.2/lib/python3.12/site-packages/qiskit_ibm_runtime/fake_provider/local_service.py:274: UserWarning: Options {'resilience': {'zne_mitigation': True, 'zne': {'noise_factors': [1.0, 3.0, 5.0], 'extrapolator': ('exponential', 'linear')}}} have no effect in local testing mode. warnings.warn(f"Options {options_copy} have no effect in local testing mode.") Job ID: ``` --- ### **Steps to reproduce** Please run the above python code as the following python notebook: (Note: Replace token with your api-key for ibm quantum cloud) [zne_ibm_with_bug.ipynb](https://gist.github.com/ayush268/2ed66963adcd30aa83a0784829f0a5be) The above notebook will seemingly terminate, but still it will spawn a lot of threads running the simulation unlike graceful termination of the python script. Please see attached screenshot: I have to manually restart the notebook (kill everything associated) to stop this. Interrupting the notebook also does not stop all the threads running the simulation. --- ### **Expected behavior** Ideally, the notebook should terminate as the script does or both script and notebook should also start a simulation and block on it, the behavior should not be different. --- ### **Suggested solutions** A clearer fix on the library side would be to either: 1. #2778 , or 2. ensure local-mode workers are daemonized / cancellable so they don't outlive the foreground task. --- ### **Additional Information** - **qiskit-ibm-runtime version**: `0.46.1` - **Python version**: `3.12.13` - **Operating system**: `Arch Linux`; `6.19.11-arch1-1`
